main_text.l: bulæ. Aut si quis juraret occidere pa-
teram diis loco & hora convenire, au[?]c-
um aliis conjuraret in societatem furti,
vel si juraret patrem senem & egenum
quæ sunt peccata Omissionis adversus præcepta
citis, ex omnium confensu etiam simpli-
antedicta, nullam esse posse ex Voto,
JCti. Imo etsi graviter peccatum fuerit
plendo promissum. Quod qui facit, du-
plicis peccati se reum constituit : uniu[?]
ejus speciei cujus est factum in se consideratum,

marginalia.note: Impia est promissio quæ scelere adimplctur[?]

page.notes: The right edge of the scan is cropped, so the ends of the body lines are cut off; only the visible letters are transcribed, and cut words are marked [?]. The marginal notes on the right are not visible. Possible misreadings: "adimplctur" (the l/ti letters are unclear), "pacisccendo", "inquiut", "uniu" and "ex irreverent" (line end cut). The footnote-style marks d and e are superscript letters in the text. The abbreviation "JC" with superscript "ti" is kept as printed.
